projects.name: OpenAI partnership
projects.quote: Expanded the OpenAI partnership with an up to approximately $6.5 billion deal, bringing total commitments to up to approximately $22.4 billion

projects.name: NVIDIA strategic collaboration
projects.quote: Agreed to a $6.3 billion strategic collaboration with NVIDIA to scale GPU infrastructure and accelerate AI innovation

projects.name: Lancaster, Pennsylvania data center
projects.quote: Announced intent to commit up to $6 billion to equip a state-of-the-art data center in Lancaster, Pennsylvania, with an initial 100 MW of capacity and expansion potential to 300 MW

projects.name: UK investment commitment
projects.quote: Announced an incremental £1.5 billion commitment in the UK, bringing the total investment to £2.5 billion, to accelerate AI innovation and growth through sustainable computing
